name: Dapagliflozin
description: A sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 inhibitor approved for type 2 diabetes, heart failure and chronic kidney disease.

systems.note: Lowers glycaemia by increasing urinary glucose loss; the intended metabolic effect, placed on the pancreas as the glycaemic system.
Heart failure outcome reduction is a labelled indication.
Chronic kidney disease progression reduction is a labelled indication.
Produces an expected early eGFR dip that reads as falling filtration but is haemodynamic, not injury.

monitors.why: Renal indication and expected initial dip.
